# lineage-openclaw-agent-workspaces

Per-agent workspace residue from OpenClaw — directory shapes and continuity
patterns. Useful when designing the v1 shared-workspace contract.

## Stack & contents

Markdown + JSON workspace state mirroring `/home/trajan/.openclaw/agents/*/workspace`. ~14,092 files across per-role agent directories: analyst, architect, chief-of-staff, coder, etc. Each role has `AGENTS.md`, `BOOTSTRAP.md`, `HEARTBEAT.md`, `IDENTITY.md`, `SOUL.md`, `TOOLS.md`, `USER.md` and an `.openclaw/workspace-state.json`. Sanitized to docs/config/scripts only.

## Why this is here

Direct empirical input for the **shared workspace contract**: shows what a per-agent durable workspace actually looks like in practice. Compare against `codebase-ema/code/ema/workspace/shared/` for the v1 shape.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/lineage-openclaw-agent-workspaces:agents/architect/IDENTITY.md
git show origin/lineage-openclaw-agent-workspaces:agents/coder/.openclaw/workspace-state.json
```
